name: @llodev/pm-tasks-linear
description: Linear adapter for the @llodev/pm-tasks-* family. Use when the user mentions Linear, asks to create a Linear issue, publish to Linear, post to Linear, transition an issue, add a comment in Linear, or uses --publish-linear; OR for CRUD on existing issues (check sub-issue, close issue, change due-date, assign person, comment, set sprint/cycle); OR when invoked autonomously by another agent with [autonomous] / --auto sentinel. Implements 10 CRUD verbs (including task.sprint.set) via the Linear MCP server. Requires @llodev/pm-tasks-core installed.
